einzeiler: Discussing the Celtics-Sixers showdown, NFL trades, and the NBA's most troubled teams
kurzfassung: The host breaks down the thrilling Celtics-Sixers game, including Paul George's stellar performance and the awkward pre-game tension between Jalen Brown and Jayson Tatum. The episode also covers recent NFL trade deadline moves, such as Kirk Cousins heading to Minnesota. Later, Rob Mahoney joins to analyze the most struggling and salary-strapped teams in the NBA early in the season.
stichpunkte: Review of the Celtics-Sixers game highlighting Paul George's rejuvenation and Jalen Brown's struggles
